name: Houdini MCP: Replay Transaction
description: Deterministically replay all operations from a previously recorded transaction. Reads the stored operation list from the TransactionManager by transaction_id, re-validates each op through the ValidationEngine, and executes them in original order via houdini_runtime.execute_operation. Supports dry_run (validate only, no execution) and rollback_on_error. Useful for deterministic scene reconstruction, retry after failure, or testing idempotency.
